svg.aria-label: ANY PAGE: One script tag and one <synthwerk-chat> element put a chat launcher on any page. DESKTOP AND MOBILE: Round launcher and panel on desktop. A full-screen sheet below 640 px. SIGN-IN FIRST: Signed-in users chat. Signed-out visitors see a sign-in prompt and send no request
